trades.ask: Bring me a Toby Jug and I'll swap you Chapbook: Morris Caper for it. I've read it twice and my knees have had enough.
trades.thanks: Lovely. That'll look grand on the sideboard. The pamphlet's yours, mind how you go.

trades.ask: Now then, I'd give £100 for Potatoes, four of them.
I'll swap you a Goss Crested China Pot for Lancashire Hotpot. It's been on the mantelpiece long enough.
trades.thanks: Go on then, it's yours. Look after it.

trades.ask: Ey up, one day I'll stop running out of brown trout. Until then, a Cheshire cheese rosette for Brown Trout, just the one.
trades.thanks: Oh, you've saved me a trip. Here you are.

trades.ask: Now then, one day I'll stop running out of parsnips. Until then, a Blue football scarf for Parsnips, three of them.
Now then, Field Mushrooms, three of them, that's my whole wish list. A Hard hat for your trouble.
Ey up, it's Lancashire Hotpot, just the one I'm short of. Help me out and a pair of round glasses is yours.
Now then, it's Roach, two of them I'm short of. Help me out and a pair of lancashire clogs is yours.
